name: ridge
expr: B0 = ridge(y, X, 0); B1 = ridge(y, X, [0.1 0.5 1 5]); Bu = ridge(y, X, 1, 0); Bm = ridge(y, X, [0 0.5], 0);
comment: Sig: B = ridge(y, X, k[, scaled]). Ridge regression on standardized X (centered + N-1 std). scaled=1 (default): coefficients in standardized space, p×length(k). scaled=0: (p+1)×length(k) with intercept in original units. Bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b on both paths.
